$comment: Per-release expectations for scripts/release/rehearse.mjs and verify-public.mjs (#300).
Each check runs against every consumer project after setup or update. Add an entry for each
user-visible fix a release delivers, and update the model default when it changes.
Fields: label, path (relative to the consumer), then one of: nothing (file exists),
contains, notContains, or jsonKey + equals. Optional: preset (only for that preset),
when: "fresh" (fresh installs only) or "current-wrapper" (skipped right after an update
run by the previous release's wrapper, which cannot have this release's update logic).
